about.title: About Blackstar Landscaping Houston
text: Blackstar Landscaping was founded in Houston in 2012 with the pursuit of creating beautiful commercial and residential spaces that people interact with. Whether we are designing a new commercial-use building or developing an outdoor recreational center, our goal is to create aesthetically pleasing and livable spaces. Surrounding every beautiful building is an equally beautiful landscape design. To have your next landscape project designed by Blackstar Landscaping, get in touch today.
